in_sanskrit.name: शर्वणा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शर्वणम् (sharvaṇam) is the Sanskrit word for 'hearing'. आ (ā) is a suffix that denotes feminine gender. ना (nā) is a suffix that denotes the abstract or goddess form.

in_hindi.name: शर्वणा
in_hindi.long_meaning: शर्वणा (śarvaṇā) is the Hindi term for 'Goddess of hearing'.

in_tamil.name: சர்வணா
in_tamil.long_meaning: சர்வம் (çarvam) means 'all' or 'everything' in Tamil. ணா (nā) is a suffix that denotes the abstract or goddess form.

in_telugu.name: శర్వణా
in_telugu.long_meaning: శర్వణా (śarvaṇā) is the Telugu term for 'Goddess of hearing'.

in_marathi.name: Sharvanaa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvanaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is the embodiment of wealth and prosperity, derived from the name Sharva, meaning wealth, and the suffix -naa, meaning Goddess.

in_bengali.name: Sharvanaa
